1. Overview

1.1 Requirements Addressed

SRS RequirementAPI Endpoint(s)
FR-001 Send Verification EmailRabbitMQ: verification.email
FR-002 Resend Verification EmailRabbitMQ: verification.email
FR-003 Track Email DeliveryPOST /api/webhooks/email/delivered
FR-004 Log Email EventsRabbitMQ: log.events

1.2 API Principles

  • Event-driven via RabbitMQ for async processing
  • Webhook callbacks for delivery tracking
  • JSON request/response
  • Stateless (JWT authentication via Better Auth)

1.3 Authentication

Webhook endpoints require signature verification.

X-Webhook-Signature: HMAC-SHA256 of request body

2. Response Format

2.1 Success Response

{
  "success": true,
  "data": { ... },
  "meta": {
    "requestId": "req-abc-123",
    "timestamp": "2026-07-24T10:30:00Z"
  }
}

2.2 Error Response

{
  "success": false,
  "error": {
    "code": "VALIDATION_ERROR",
    "message": "Invalid input data",
    "details": [
      { "field": "email", "message": "Invalid email format" }
    ]
  }
}

3. Error Codes

HTTP StatusError CodeDescription
400EMAIL_001Invalid email address
400EMAIL_002Email template not found
502EMAIL_003Provider error - delivery failed
429EMAIL_004Rate limit exceeded
401EMAIL_005Invalid webhook signature

Endpoint CategoryRequests/minBurst
Webhook endpoints10050

5. Endpoints

5.1 Webhook Endpoints

POST /api/webhooks/email/delivered FR-003

Receives email delivery status callback from email provider.

Request:

{
  "verification_id": "string (required)",
  "status": "delivered | failed (required)",
  "provider_message_id": "string (required)",
  "error_message": "string | null (optional)"
}

Response 200:

{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Webhook processed"
}

Response 400:

{
  "success": false,
  "error": "Invalid webhook payload"
}

6. Pagination

All list endpoints support offset pagination.

GET /email/logs?page=2&limit=20

7. Webhook Events

7.1 RabbitMQ Queues

verification.email

Queue for email verification requests from AUTH module.

EventProducerDescription
verification.email.requestedAUTHUser requests email verification
verification.email.resentAUTHUser resends email verification

Message Format

{
  "user_id": "uuid",
  "email": "string",
  "channel": "email",
  "otp": "string",
  "verification_id": "string"
}

log.events

Queue for publishing email delivery events to Logger module.

EventProducerDescription
email.event.loggedEMAILEmail delivery event (sent, delivered, failed)
